highlights: A largely virtual War Week: COVID meant the whole team could not gather under one roof, with remote and in-person options for events.
War Week 2021 marked the official roll out of EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) at JG, with a mandatory EOS Roll Out on Monday night.
Closing Ceremonies moved from Saturday morning to Friday evening due to COVID.
Core Values Awards (Serve, Grind, Grow, Inspire) were presented by the executive team; Grind went to top billable hours.
Code Wars held its 5th annual War Week event.
Counter-Strike Captain Clash: SZ vs JK drafted teams for a best-of-one match, with a knife bonus for stabbing the opposing executive.
